replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Hello Windyh,

I'm the moderator that banned you. As you said you spammed "ALT+F4=DIAMOND SWORD".
And you mentioned the Ip of the Overcast Network, since you spoke spanish I wasn't sure what you said.
I just checked the logs again and translated your messages, but in fact you did not advertise.
You were just rude and scammed.

If you want to see the chat logs, here you go (I highlighted your messages):
http://pastebin.com/WRUgKk4z

Well, since you did not evade your punishment and already served 2 months banned I'll appeal your ban.
But just to be safe you should read the rules again so it doesn't happen again!
Welcome back!

Regards Flo/resepignev :)
